      Our Commitment

      Full Commitment to Your Schedule

      Texas Technical Services Co. (TTS) is committed to health and safety, the environment and quality is delivered by adopting an integrated approach to our management systems, and complying with all relevant legislation, regulations and other legal and industry requirements.
      This provides a framework for integration of the ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 9001:2015 standards and is externally certificated by a UASL accredited certification body.
      We are committed to providing comprehensive end-to-end metering solutions through our strategic partnerships with reputable OEMs.

      Our ServicesOur Products
      Together We Thrive

      Our Partners, Our Strength.

      Sick

      SICK is one of the world's leading producers of sensors and sensor solutions for industrial automation applications. Since 1946.

      Faure Herman

      Faure Herman supplies high quality helical turbine flowmeters and ultrasonic flowmeters for oil and gas, aviation and other industries. Since 1925

      Omni

      OMNI is a leading brand in oil and gas flow computers, renowned for reliability. Their expertise ensures tailored solutions for complex needs.

      Pyrotech

      Pyrotech Workspace Solutions is a pioneer in delivering turnkey Control Room Solutions and Ergonomic Command Centre Console.

      BIS

      Balaji Industrial Services, Established in 1978, A leading Service Provider in SCADA, PLC and other specialized process industries Automation Solutions
      What we offer

      Innovative Solutions for Business Excellence

      We possess extensive expertise in various aspects of Inspection and testing , Liquid and Gas Custody Metering systems. Our services encompass inspection and testing, metering control system upgrades, maintenance and validation of metering systems, and specialized consultancy services. We are committed to providing comprehensive end-to-end metering solutions through our strategic partnerships with reputable OEMs.

      How we work?

      Our unwavering commitment to HSE policies prioritizes the well-being of our employees, stakeholders, and the environment, underpinned by a fundamental belief in prevention through proactive measures and strict compliance with regulations. We see preventing accidents and environmental incidents as both a moral imperative and a smart business strategy.
